allocation_rule.confirmed_condition: Prior 26-week gross growth-sleeve return is positive and exceeds the ETF incumbent
exceptional_conditions: Prior 13-week gross growth-sleeve return is positive
At least three of the five current holdings have positive 13-week momentum
No one positive holding supplies more than 60% of the current holdings' summed positive 13-week returns
Prior 13-week growth-sleeve volatility is no more than 1.5 times prior 52-week volatility

universal_stock_cap.scope: all fundamental holdings without ticker-specific exceptions

selection_policy: Track 50% and 60% exceptional tiers in parallel for 52 weeks. Historical leadership cannot promote either.
retrospective_falsification_status: failed single-stock exclusion and parameter-neighborhood gates; forward tracking is shadow observation only
